products.name: Classic Oxford Button-Down Shirt
products.description: This classic Oxford shirt is tailored for a polished yet casual look. Crafted from high-quality cotton, it features a button-down collar and a comfortable, slightly relaxed fit. Perfect for both formal and casual occasions, it comes with long sleeves, a button placket, and a yoke at the back. The shirt is finished with a gently rounded hem and adjustable button cuffs.
